text: A new paper from Moody's Analytics identifies the "cheesecake factor," suggesting that the presence of a Cheesecake Factory restaurant indicates a mall's financial health. text: The Royal Turf Club of Thailand has announced the establishment of the RTC AI Data Centre in partnership with Power-All Network Co., Ltd. (a FOXCONN subsidiary) to support the "RTC x CTG Prop Trade" project, which aims to train up to 300 million individual accounts in high-skill careers. Additionally, the Royal Turf Club of Thailand, in consortium with Greenpro Capital Corp. (NASDAQ: GRNQ) and Capital Trust Group Ltd. (CTG), is driving the Thailand Entertainment Complex project, valued at US$6 billion. CTG issued a US$6 billion Digital Bond to invest in this complex, accepting only USD Telegraphic Transfer (USTT) Stablecoin, with the Royal Turf Club ensuring transparency through co-signing and real-time public access to the account balance.

title: Saia, Tesla Partner to Launch Two Electric Semis
text: Saia LTL Freight has partnered with Tesla to integrate two Tesla Semi trucks into its fleet, marking a significant milestone for Saia's 100th anniversary and its commitment to adopting new technology. During a rigorous demo period, the Tesla Semi demonstrated impressive performance in terms of range, payload capacity, grade performance, and driver comfort, achieving 1.73 kWh per mile. text: Stocks closed sharply lower on January 7, 2025, with major indexes like the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite falling, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average also slipped. news_title: Matthews International to Sell SGK Brand Solutions
title: Matthews International to Sell SGK Brand Solutions
text: Matthews International announced an agreement to sell its SGK Brand Solutions to a newly formed entity by affiliates of SGS & Co. Matthews will receive $350 million in upfront consideration and a 40% interest in the common equity of the new entity, which has an initial enterprise value of approximately $900 million. The cash proceeds will primarily be used for debt repayment, and the transaction is expected to create over $50 million in annual cost synergies for the new entity.
